svg.title: Benchmark teaser (R43, clockwork variant V43y)
svg.desc: Editable vector teaser R43: the LLM agent workspace (explore, build, inspect, reflect around the agent) on the left and shielded trusted policy execution with protected resources on the right, split by an evaluation gateway crossed by Submit policy and Trajectory information + metrics (payload chips hang under it). Attempt progression under the agent side is a clock ring whose arcs are Attempt 1, 2, 3 with Eval ticks, each carrying a tiny copy of the loop; a heavy kept-policies arrow runs right inside the lower panels and up into the after-run independent assessment on held-out seeds, and six real task snapshots run in one row below. Colours: seaborn deep, with each panel border in its theme mid-tone.
